# Chockwise

> Airport gate data by airline, from flight data: how many gates each airline has at 248 airports, which terminal it uses, departures a day and nonstop routes. Data as of Nov 2, 2026.

How we count: a gate is an airline's when that airline (including its regional partners) flies at least 70% of the arrivals and departures there over the data window shown on each page. Gates no airline dominates are "common use". Counts on the airport page and the airline-at-airport page are always the same number. Each page says the days its numbers come from.

## Key pages
- [Airports](https://chockwise.com/airports/): gates by airline at 248 airports
- [Airlines](https://chockwise.com/airlines/): gates and terminals for 411 airlines
- [Routes](https://chockwise.com/routes): nonstop routes and flights a day
